description: ACT Crime Statistics and Data is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by ACT Policing. Summary statistics and an interactive map showing data on criminal offences, including traffic infringements, are published by ACT Policing. Data is available to view on the map for suburbs and postcodes and can be downloaded for larger patrol regions as an Excel (XLSX) spreadsheet. Coverage is the states and territories, 2014 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is other non-commercial licence (terms not stated in the catalogue). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
licence: other non-commercial licence (terms not stated in the catalogue)
